overview: Based on the published agenda, the Los Altos Hills City Council was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to address multiple substantive items including amendments to alarm systems regulations, affordable housing incentives, a potential community service officer program, and updates from ad hoc committees on legal services and the Williamson Act. The meeting was set to consider several ordinances and resolutions affecting municipal code and town operations.
actions: Scheduled to vote on approval of Special Meeting Minutes from September 17, 2026
Scheduled to vote on approval of Regular Meeting Minutes from September 17, 2026
Scheduled to consider Resolution Authorizing 2026 Town Hall Holiday Closure
Scheduled to consider Resolution Updating Transfer of Unclaimed Funds to Originating Fund
Set for public hearing and scheduled to consider introduction of ordinance amending alarm systems regulations
Set for public hearing and scheduled to consider introduction of ordinance creating affordable housing incentives for extremely low-income households
Set for public hearing and scheduled to consider introduction of ordinance amending construction time limits
Scheduled to discuss community service officer program and provide direction on next steps
Scheduled to consider History Committee request to reinstall De Anza Trek plaque at Edith Park
Scheduled to consider continued support for Joint Volunteer Awards Committee and December 4, 2026 recognition event
